closedOwnerDecisions.title: [Launch P0] Resolve AGPL compliance and Mac App Store distribution compatibility
closedOwnerDecisions.decision: The owner selected the Mac App Store with Apple In-App Purchase. This closes the channel decision only; source/licence/notices review remains a release gate.

issues.title: [Launch P0] Build a production Mac App Store package and safe data migration
issues.progress: The App Store profile now retains com.zenuml.app, ZenUML 1.1.0 build 41. Strict read-only legacy decoding and local paid-primary-functionality tests are implemented. Complete final native upgrade acceptance and fresh Apple signing before distribution.

issues.title: [Launch P0] Add native StoreKit purchase, restore and subscription management
issues.progress: Native purchase UI and bridge are implemented; live products and StoreKit verification remain unavailable. Define and verify continued primary-feature access for existing paid purchasers before adding subscription gates.

issues.title: [Launch P0] Verify Apple transactions and reconcile Diagramly entitlements
issues.progress: Backend connection and delivery work is on a separate branch, default-off, and awaiting critical fixes and live verification.

issues.title: [Launch P0] Finalize Apple subscription offer, allowance costs and product catalogue
issues.progress: Pricing remains a proposal; no products or final service allowance are configured.

issues.title: [Launch P1] Establish Diagramly Desktop name, icon and consistent product identity
issues.progress: Owner approved a gradual move from ZenUML to the Diagramly brand and reuse of the existing app record (1602636196, com.zenuml.app). Store metadata is unchanged; icon approval, profile identity alignment and final bundle remain open.

issues.title: [Launch P1] Prepare truthful App Store listing, screenshots, demo and support pages
issues.progress: Listing and synthetic examples are drafts; support pages are committed locally but not deployed, and no shipping-build screenshots exist.

issues.title: [Launch P0] Audit desktop data flows, privacy disclosures and local security boundaries
issues.progress: Implementation evidence is being assembled; privacy and final sandbox review are not complete.

issues.title: [Launch P0] Prove clean-machine beta, data recovery and Apple purchase lifecycle
issues.progress: Local test suites cover parts of the workflows; clean-machine acceptance and live Apple purchase lifecycle remain.

issues.title: [Launch P1] Establish support, incident response and measurable go-to-market operations
issues.progress: Internal playbooks and draft measurement plan exist; support pages are not deployed and no response-time commitment is published.
